source.source_hint_policy: Only hints resolvable entirely against cards.json are included.

notes: Attested multi-character examples remain the primary learning examples.
Source-table hints are added only when every character and every Jyutping syllable can be resolved against cards.json.
Cards with no safe multi-character example receive a single-character fallback rather than an invented phrase.
single_char fallbacks are not counted as phrase coverage.
Only function/interjection single-character fallbacks are marked sentence_ready=true.
